run_fim_training: run fill-in-the-middle causal language model fine-tuning on a dataset without using HuggingFace Trainer
fine_tune_model_fim: fine-tune a pretrained causal language model using fill-in-the-middle objective on a text file or dataset
apply_fim_transformation: apply fill-in-the-middle transformation with prefix-suffix-middle and suffix-prefix-middle modes to tokenized text data
add_fim_tokens_model: add special fill-in-the-middle tokens to a tokenizer and resize model embedding layer with multivariate normal initialization
train_model_accelerate: train a language model using PyTorch and Accelerate library with gradient accumulation and distributed training support
